## Verdict: PASS

N-49's second defect is fixed. The bound holds, the seed is pinned, a sweep and a property guard it, the case still
exercises slot reuse, and the pre-fix data reproduces the ruling's failure. Every gate is green or red only for causes
outside the item. No new blocker was found. Two survivors from 10 targeted mutants are classified below with evidence:
one is equivalent to the case's promise, and one is a hardening test on code this round did not change. Both are
written as notes.

| line | the re-run | status | label |

## (3) New findings and mutants

Ten targeted mutants were run. Each aims at the bound, at the claims of the new test, or at the case not degenerating. The kill set was `testkit/test/constructive/` (near) plus the related files that run this case: `test/runner/constructive.test.ts` and `bench/test/fuzz-bar/entry.test.ts`. It ran in the mirror with N-49's M0-k-04 follow-on applied, so a kill could not hide behind a stale-known row. The baseline was `Tests 750 passed (750)`. CONFIRMED by `mutants.jsonl`.

| id | mutant | result |
|---|---|---|
| K01 | gap = d.log(1000, 2¹⁸) (pre-fix) | killed: indexes.test 3/3 red, and runner seed 2 `met 1 edges, 1 vertices` |
| K02 | gap = d.log(L + 50, 2¹⁸) | killed: sweep and property |
| K03 | gap = d.log(L + 99, 2¹⁸) | **survives**; equivalent to the promise (see N-11) |
| K04 | gap = d.log(L + 51, 2¹⁸) | killed: sweep and property |
| K05 | boxOld widened to L + 150 | killed: sweep and property |
| K06 | fresh starts at gap − 60 | killed: pin, sweep and property |
| K07 | fresh's second vertex at gap − L (runs back into boxOld) | killed: indexes.test, the runner and fuzz-bar |
| K08 | gap's upper bound 2¹⁶ (lo > hi for large L) | killed: cases.test, indexes.test and replay.test |
| K09 | `removeEdges` step dropped | killed: runner (boxOld query meets old) and fuzz-bar |
| K10 | `removeEdges` moved after fresh's insert | **survives** (see N-12) |

**K03 is equivalent to the case's promise, so it is a note and not a blocker** (CONFIRMED). The case promises that the boxOld query returns nothing once old is freed. Probe P3 slides fresh along its axis on seeds 2, 1045 and 5683 and runs the judge on each. Clearance 50, 49, 10 and 1 are all `green`. Clearance 0 and −1 fail with `query-returns-new-item: a query expected to meet nothing met 1 edges`, because boxOld is a closed box. So any gap ≥ L + 51 keeps the promise, and so does the ruling's "never overlap". The ≥ 50 cm in the ruling is slack. K03 changes only that slack, and it changes it on about 3.7 × 10⁻⁴ of seeds (P2). It survives because seeds 0 – 999 hold no exact-bound seed: the first is 1045. N-11 suggests pinning seed 1045.

**K10 is a missing hardening test on code this round did not change, so it is a note and not a blocker** (CONFIRMED by a probe; the classification is this seat's judgement). With `removeEdges` after the fresh insert, P1 on the mirror gives `reuse 0, noReuse 200, green 200`: the case no longer reuses a slot, yet every test is green. The judge's `query-returns-new-item` checks the queries, not the reuse. The step order is unchanged since the case landed (this round changed only the `gap` line), and the current code reuses on 2 000 of 2 000 draws, so no honest input gets a wrong result. A guard against a future reorder is a further hardening test, and under FAIL SAFE NOW (N-45, J202) that is a note. The judge it would extend (`invariants/constructive.ts`) is M0-k-04's. The session may veto this call. If it does, the required change is: add a `slot-reused` hold to `index/slot-reuse-stage` (and to `-districts`), and add a judge check that the vertex and pair tops after the fresh insert equal those after the removal and that the free lists are drained.

No other new finding. Every interface and test id the item lists is present (`CONSTRUCTIVE_SET`, `casesAt` and the listed tests are unchanged by the round; near is 570/570). There is no stub, TODO or skip in the two changed files (read whole). C-0234 names the section, the choice, the behaviour shift (seed 2's draws, stated once, with no golden holding them) and the test. The author's row L-0245 lists reads inside `plat/` only. All paths are under `plat/`.
